people.name: Macedonia
people.line: A region in northern Greece; Paul preached there

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.
translations.bsb: When the uproar had ended, Paul sent for the disciples. And after encouraging them, he said goodbye to them and left for Macedonia.
translations.kjv: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed for to go into Macedonia.
translations.asv: And after the uproar ceased, Paul having sent for the disciples and exhorted them, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.
